payload.description:
Implement continuation from durable structured model and tool events.

Acceptance criteria:
- Model requests, tool calls, tool results, and attempt transitions are durable typed events, not transient token chunks.
- The old attempt commits the pending call and relinquishes fenced ownership before continuation.
- The new attempt claims the same turn and executes only unresolved calls.
- Action identifiers make tool execution retry-aware.
- Failure-injection scenarios cover every handoff boundary and computer reclamation.
payload.title: Implement the structured journal and fenced computer handoff
